Solvane uses Automation to move files, send items to the Trash, open requested commands and control playback in your media apps.
Solvane uses each app's audio to adjust its volume in the mixer, to move Dynamic Island's music bars and to include the Mac's sound in the screen recordings you start. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Solvane uses Bluetooth only to read the battery level of connected peripherals. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Solvane uses your location once in a while to pick the nearest city for the prayer times. The location is not saved or sent anywhere; only the city you end up with is kept.

Solvane records your microphone only when you turn it on for a screen recording. The audio stays on your Mac unless you choose to create a temporary link.
Show your upcoming appointments in the notch. Calendar events stay on this Mac.
Solvane shows your camera only in the preview window you open, so you can check how you look before a call. Nothing is recorded or leaves your Mac.
Solvane checks local metadata in Downloads to review, organize or trash only confirmed WhatsApp files you choose. The Cleaner also looks for forgotten screenshots when you save screenshots here.
Solvane organizes confirmed WhatsApp downloads in a destination folder you explicitly choose. The Cleaner also looks for forgotten screenshots when you save screenshots here.
